profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Conversational AI, RAG, LLM Evaluators, Full Stack | Shipping production AI features at scale, $1M+ Engineering Productivity Impact
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Conversational Search
positions.description:
• Spearheaded Redfin’s first AI-powered conversational search (3-engineer team, 2 months) which
delivered 70%+ relevancy via LLM reranker (GPT-4.1 Nano) and drove higher user retention than
traditional search. Try it out here: https://www.redfin.com/chat
• Led AI integration for Redfin’s AI home details by engineering prompts, connecting to
internal AI Gateway with online judge evaluator for automated guardrail corrections across 2M+
listings ultimately driving SEO impression growth
• Built Redfin’s first Relevance Judge end-to-end using Gemini computer use, Browserbase, and internal
property data services to evaluate search result quality against user queries; system now benchmarks
Conversational Search relevancy and directly informs roadmap prioritization
• Championed enterprise adoption of Cursor and Browserbase by guiding security reviews and legal
approval processes, resulting in signed contracts and projected $1M+ in annual engineering productivity
saving

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Proposed performance improvement for Seller flow which increased consults by 2.8% leading to an
increase of $250,0000+ in revenue
• Led development of personalized AI text service generating nearly 35% of all first messages sent to
customers; utilized prompt engineering techniques such as Chain-of-thought, few-shot, and evaluators
• Collaborated with Search team to reduce total Javascript downloaded by 40%+ contributing to an
overall 25% improvement in the Interaction to Next Paint (INP) moving our performance rankings from
4th to 2nd
• Led team’s Datadog migration and advised Monitoring team on Datadog’s gaps to properly expose
necessary metrics for many of Redfin’s frontend features and SLOs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Reduced JSON payload by 25% for high traffic form and implemented pre-fetching in Javascript for high volume forms, leading to 80% reduction in loading times which ultimately increased new customers by 6% m/m adding approximately $1-2 million in revenue
• Partnered with engineers, product managers, and designers across Redfin to deliver Premier Redfin
agents MVP growing high revenue contacts by 5%
• Modeled foundation of end to end Selenium testing for forms framework, unlocking the ability for feature teams to easily onboard and write automation tests
• Authored three different solutions to editing test templates in order to improve UX, drive cross-functional adoption, and reduce potential test failures due to database inconsistencies
• Mentored intern from Ada Developers Academy, a program aimed to serve unrepresented individuals in tech

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description:
• Launched API service using AWS Lambda to parse logs, Kinesis Firehose for streaming, and S3 as
storage to create an overall audit trail
• Implemented time range filtering in order to reduce latency from subsequent calls by 70%
• Evaluated and finalized storage model for supply chain logs, reducing costs by nearly 30%
• Formulated cost analysis report to consider up to over 2 billion records ingested a month
• Molded foundation for alternate paths using Elastic Search

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Efficiently implemented API endpoint for overview tree, reducing network latency by 50%
• Designed and merged multiple network requests to allows users to copy and move tree models
• Responsible for creating deepcopy functionality for custom nested Django model instances
• Parsed tree API data for issues with empty values and constructed serializer to handle those cases

company.name: The B. John Garrick Institute for the Risk Sciences at UCLA

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Developed Python scripts to consolidate problem files, generate HTCondor scripts to run problem sets in parallel through SSH, and visualized results using Matplotlib, NumPy, and Pandas
• Facilitated execution of experimental algorithms that sustained 10% more accuracy for large (no exact value) problems and 100%+ for small (exact value possible) problems
• Worked with research team to fully test abstraction sampling algorithms on over hundreds of problem sets ranging from pedigrees to promedas
